title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Four-keyword rotation (DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer) against the /jobs/remote/dev-ops?search= endpoint. Scores measure technical and domain fit only.
latest_update: Rechecked September 19, 2026 — 7 new eligible candidates, best fit Mogo/StackAdapt/Branch at score 7.

rows.title: DevOps Staff Platform Engineer
rows.gap: OCI is unfamiliar (AWS/multi-cloud accepted); the role's AI-agent-tooling framing (Claude Code/Cursor daily use, MCP gateways, agent identity/audit) is genuinely supported by Marc's real AI-assisted-engineering practice at Énergir, not a cold stretch

rows.title: Senior AI DevOps & Reliability Engineer
rows.gap: None material — direct overlap on Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, Python/Bash, Prometheus/Grafana; the AI-first tooling expectation (Claude Code) is a genuine strength given Énergir's AI-assisted-engineering work, not a gap. Note: explicitly states no relocation/visa sponsorship — Marc must already be Canada-based, which he is

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: None material — Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, and networking all overlap directly with Marc's real experience (Puppet specifically from Tink)

rows.title: Staff DevOps Engineer
rows.location: Remote — Ontario (Toronto-anchored, "Hiring Remotely in Toronto, ON, CAN")
rows.gap: ML/AI infrastructure support (training clusters, model serving, GPU workload scheduling) is not established in the profile; core DevOps/Kubernetes/Terraform/CI-CD requirements otherwise align

rows.title: Staff Software Engineer - Platform and Cloud Services
rows.gap: Role's actual center of gravity is service/product architecture engineering (event-driven AWS-native services, API and data-model design) more than infrastructure-operations DevOps, despite real AWS/IaC/CI-CD keywords present

rows.title: Software Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
rows.gap: Reads as a product/infra software-engineering IC role (building a service from scratch, code-sample required) rather than operations/platform-enablement work; less aligned than the title alone suggests

rows.title: Expert DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Requires proven agentic-AI-platform infrastructure build experience specifically (SDN micro-segmentation, agent policy/control planes) — Marc's cloud/IaC depth is real but this is a narrow, cutting-edge specialization he hasn't built. Same company flagged for the identical reason in a prior run (job_sources.md, 2026-09-08)

notes_sections.heading: Pipeline matches — not rescored/refiled
items: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes team) — StackAdapt: this BuiltIn posting (10882772) validated at score 7 on a full read, but the same role is already Applied in applications.md via a LinkedIn posting (2026-09-18, scored only 4 there — "AWS dated/by-hand, Kubernetes provisioning-side"). Same company + exact title = the same underlying req cross-posted; not refiled, but worth noting the scoring gap between a thin LinkedIn read and BuiltIn's fuller description — the LinkedIn score may have undersold it.
Senior or Staff Site Reliability Engineer (26248) — Enverus: same job code (26248) as the already-Applied Indeed posting from 2026-08-25 (score 7). Confirmed duplicate, not refiled.

notes_sections.heading: Ineligible
items: Site Reliability Engineer, Client Platform — Hadrian: US-only, requires US citizen/national/lawful-permanent-resident status under ITAR. Repeat exclusion (job_sources.md, 2026-09-08).
DevSecOps Engineer — Sparksoft Corporation: requires having lived in the United States 3 of the past 5 years; Canada-based workers not eligible despite a Bristol, QC office listed.
Senior DevSecOps Engineer — Sparksoft Corporation: same US-residency-history requirement, plus mandatory AWS certification and US Public Trust clearance.
IT / DevSecOps Engineer Contractor — Rain (rain aero): "Must be a U.S. Person" under export-control law; also a part-time student/recent-grad role. Repeat exclusion (job_sources.md, 2026-09-08).

notes_sections.heading: Hard-gated
items: Cloud Engineer - Kubernetes and GCP — Cardinal Health: GCP/GKE is the explicit primary platform requirement — hits the profile's GCP hard gate directly. Capped 0–4.

notes_sections.heading: Unclear eligibility — not scored
items: DevOps Engineer (Founding Team) — Fabrion: San Francisco Bay Area headquartered, 7 locations listed but Canada eligibility not explicitly confirmed in the posting. Needs a direct check before scoring, per the geography rule against assuming eligibility from an ambiguous "In-Office or Remote" label.

notes_sections.heading: Not opened this run — volume boundary
items: 78 unique postings surfaced across the 4-keyword rotation; 20 were opened for full validation (7 new eligible + 2 pipeline matches + 6 ineligible/hard-gated + 1 unclear + 4 already covered by existing builtin.json rows, e.g. Elastic Senior SRE Observability & Analytics). The remaining ~58 were screened by title only: clear scope exclusions not opened include 2× full-stack/app-dev roles, 4× Cloud/Data Security Engineer roles (security-analyst center of gravity, not DevOps), 2× data-engineering-centered Cloud/Data Engineer roles, 1 explicitly Junior SRE posting, and several URL/title-mismatched low-ID postings (e.g. a "Site Reliability Engineer" at slug ai-support-engineer/4452256, a "Cloud Platform Engineer" at slug site-reliability-engineer/4452205) that look like stale reposted permalinks.

Plausible-but-not-yet-opened backlog worth a follow-up pass: Staff Backend Engineer (Core DevOps), plain "DevOps Engineer" (11187585), DevOps & Golang Developer, DevOps Engineer – Senior (10778433), Senior DevOps Engineer (11125369), Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) (9080747), Site Reliability Engineer (10644498), Site Reliability Engineer, Robotics, Site Reliability Engineer (Monetization), 2× plain Site Reliability Engineer (8247517, 9823851), Site Reliability Developer 1, Cloud Platform Engineer — AI/3D, Senior Cloud Engineer (10689558, a different req from the scored Vistex one), and GPU Cloud Platform Engineer.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: Ran the standing 4-keyword rotation (DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer) — Platform Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer stay skipped per the 2026-09-08 note (historically noisy, mostly non-infra results).
Direct HTTP retrieval against builtin.com/jobs/remote/dev-ops?search=<term> worked cleanly for both search results and individual job pages — no browser needed this run.

Genuinely encouraging pattern this run: three separate employers (Mogo, Branch, and to a lesser extent Nexxa) are explicitly recruiting for AI-agent-aware DevOps/Platform roles that value hands-on use of tools like Claude Code — Marc's real AI-assisted-engineering practice at Énergir is a direct, defensible answer to that requirement, not an analogy.
No CAPTCHA, verification prompt, or write-side action occurred.
